claim: On 2025-07-03 the maximum Aurora cluster storage volume doubled from 128 TiB to 256 TiB for Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition. The Aurora features page now gives 256 TiB as the maximum size of the database volume, and the Aurora size-limits list says the maximum varies by engine version.

qualifiers.condition: Aurora cluster volume maximum size varies by engine version

evidence.quote: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition now supports a maximum storage limit of 256 TiB, doubling the previous limit of 128 TiB.
Your database volume expands in increments of 10 GB up to a maximum of 256 TiB so you never need to provision excess storage in advance.
Aurora cluster volume maximum size varies by engine version:
